profile.headline: Full Stack Web Developer/Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Full stack developer with experience in software engineering and development, supporting both the Department of Defense (DOD) and private sector industries.
Highly creative and proficient, known for a strong work ethic and exceptional abilities in communication and problem-solving. Possessing finely honed organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
ASP.NET Core ·  ASP.NET · C# · VUE.JS ·  JQuery ·  CSS · HTML5 · Newtonsoft.JSON  · Rest APIs · SQL · Visual Studio · VSCode · Entity Framework · Bootstrap · BitBucket · JIRA · PostMan · ScreamingFrog 
· Project Lead - DOD Credentialing Standards Assessment Web Site
· Project Lead DB Migration to Azure
· DOD COOL Sites development and maintenance
· Data management web app development and maintenance.
· SSMS design, development and maintenance.
· Improving and automating manual processes optimizing efficiency and reducing costs

positions.title: Junior Application Developer
positions.description: Full Stack web developer. Financial analysis dashboard responsive design: C#, D3, JQuery, JavaScript, SQL Server, IIS, DataTables, JSTree, HighCharts,  Bootstrap, HTML, CSS. Sharepoint document management system: Sharepoint, C#, Entity Framework, SQL Server, JQuery, JavaScript. Camunda,  Git, EasyUI, Visual Studio, VSTS.

positions.title: PHP Full Stack Web Developer
positions.description: As PHP Web Developer converted PDF's into a responsive, user friendly website. Developed, designed, implemented, tested, and deployed a student application website for a post high school institution, using a PHP, MySQL JavaScript back end and an HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, front end. Including a new financial database for tuition assistance evaluation, tuition agreements, payment schedules, and payment processing.

positions.title: Graduate
positions.description:
Passion for programming drew me to this comprehensive web development immersive program.

Languages & Frameworks: PHP | Ruby | JavaScript | Ruby on Rails | jQuery |     				Angular | Express | Node | AJAX | HTML | CSS 

Management & Deployment: RSpec | Git | GitHub | Heroku | Command Line

Databases: SQL | PostgreSQL | MongoDB

Methodologies: Object Oriented Programming | MVC Pattern | Test-Driven Development | 
Responsive Design: Bootstrap 3 | Devise

Authentication: User Stories | ERDs | Wireframing

positions.title: Office Manager
positions.description:
Developed/maintained databases using Access.

Managed a $200,000 budget including: payroll, accounts payable, accounts receivable, taxes, and procurement.  Executive assistant responsibilities: communications, scheduling, board meetings and travel arrangements. Served as liaison for 40 field operators, 60 business owners, and organization's executive staff.  Maintained continuity for a full year during total redesign of organization's business plan.
